meta.title: HerSafe — Community Safety Platform
meta.description: Report harassment anonymously, explore community safety data, and stay informed with HerSafe.

home.hero_subtitle: HerSafe lets you report harassment anonymously, see which areas your community marks safer, and help build a clearer, kinder map of the everyday.
home.mission_body: Most harassment goes unspoken because reporting feels exposing. HerSafe removes that cost — no names, no faces, no accusations. Just patterns the community can see and respond to.
home.recent_empty: No reports yet in this area.
home.map_preview_body: Green, amber, and red markers reflect aggregated, anonymous report density — never individual identities.

report.title: Report an incident
report.subtitle: Every field except location is optional. Nothing here is ever made public with identifying details.
report.privacy_note: We never collect names, photos, or identifying details of any person involved. This report is anonymous by default.
report.service_area_notice: HerSafe currently covers Egypt only. If you're not in Egypt, this report can't be located on our map yet.
report.hotline_notice: In immediate danger? Call 112, or the Anti-Harassment & Violence Against Women hotline on 15115.
report.error_outside_egypt: This location looks like it's outside Egypt. HerSafe currently only maps incidents within Egypt.
report.field_description_placeholder: Describe the incident in your own words (no names, please)
report.evidence_body: Paste links to your own Google Drive files. We never host or copy your files.
report.evidence_warning: Sharing Google Drive links is optional. Users are responsible for controlling access permissions to their own files.
report.success_body: Thank you. Your report is anonymous and has been added to the community record.
report.error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
report.error_location: We couldn't detect your location. You can still pick it on the map or type a city name.

map.title: Safety map
map.subtitle: Aggregated, anonymous incident density by area.

statistics.title: Community statistics
statistics.subtitle: Aggregated numbers only — never individual details.
statistics.no_data: Not enough data yet for this view.

guide.title: Safety guide
guide.subtitle: Practical guidance and emergency numbers, organized by region.
guide.emergency_note: HerSafe currently covers Egypt only. These are official Egyptian emergency lines — confirm they're current before you rely on them.

about.title: About HerSafe
about.mission_body: To make everyday harassment visible as a pattern, without exposing any individual — so communities and institutions can respond to what the data shows.
about.vision_body: A world where reporting harassment costs nothing and prevents more of it.
about.privacy_body: No accounts are required to report. We never publish names, photos, or identifying details. Read our full Privacy Policy for details.
about.opensource_body: HerSafe's code is open for review, audit, and contribution.

footer.rights: All community data is anonymous and aggregated.
